## Summary

[Partial] Apply Herculiner to the rocker panels and use four-inch roller with foam or heavy nap. [t769]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Apply Herculiner to the rocker panels, stopping at the door sill seam or bend if desired.
2. Ensure coats are thick enough to cover but light enough to prevent running.

_Procedure reported by [t769]._

## Tools

- Armor All, High Gloss recommended [t769]
